Subject: Discovery follow-up: scheduling demo & technical deep dive

Hi Alex / Rebecca —

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap from our side:
- Primary goals: reduce inference latency for customer-facing search + centralize embedding pipelines for analytics.
- Key constraints: VPC-only deployment preferred, strict data retention controls, and throughput ~2M tokens/day with occasional spikes.

Next steps we discussed: schedule a 60–90 minute session that includes a product demo and a short technical deep dive with your DevOps/infra lead to validate networking and security (VPC/KMS).

I pulled a couple of slots (PDT):
- Wed 4/7, 10:00–11:30
- Thu 4/8, 13:00–14:30
- Fri 4/9, 09:30–11:00

Can you confirm which works and who from your side will attend (names + roles)? I’ll include Camila (Solutions Engineer) and Rafael (Customer Success) from our side.

Attached: redwood_pricing_summary.pdf with a baseline estimate and a short demo agenda (demo-agenda.docx).

If those times don’t work, send over two alternatives and we’ll align.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198
